desc: Precompute prefix frequency counts: for each index i, store the frequency of each number in nums[0..i-1].
Precompute suffix frequency counts: for each index i, store the frequency of each number in nums[i+1..n-1].
Iterate over each index i from 2 to n-3 (as the middle element), treating nums[i] as the middle mode candidate.

For each middle element, count the number of ways to choose 2 elements from the left and 2 from the right such that the total count of the middle element is strictly greater than the count of any other element in the 5-element subsequence.

To efficiently count valid pairs, iterate over all possible values for the other 4 elements, ensuring that for any value v != middle, its total count (left_count + right_count) is less than the middle element's total count (1 + left_count_middle + right_count_middle).
Sum up all valid combinations modulo 10^9 + 7 and return the result.
